meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Markdown 变成公众号文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你用 Markdown 写公众号,希望快速排版发布。
copy.tagline_en: Turn Markdown into WeChat Official Account articles.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write WeChat posts in Markdown and want quick formatting and publishing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能调用本地命令工具：把 Markdown 文章转成微信公众号排版用的 HTML，并能在用户需要时检查可用主题、生成封面或配图、创建草稿、按指定风格写作、给出标题建议、去除 AI 痕迹。
howto.when: 当你要求把 Markdown 转成公众号文章 HTML、生成文章配图或封面、或要求按指定风格写作/去除 AI 痕迹时触发；上传图片或建草稿只在你明确要求时才执行。

say.text: 把这份 Markdown 转成公众号文章 HTML。
say.note: 会先检查文章是否就绪，再转换生成 HTML。

say.text: 给这篇稿子取几个标题候选。
say.note: 只产出候选标题，不替你定稿或发布。

say.text: 按已配置的公众号账号把这篇稿子存成草稿。
say.note: 需要已配置的公众号凭证；会先查就绪状态。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use a CLI to turn Markdown into WeChat Official Account HTML, check available themes, generate covers or images, create drafts, write in a creator style, suggest titles, and remove AI traces.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to convert Markdown to WeChat article HTML, generate a cover or article image, or request style-based writing/AI-trace removal. Uploads or drafts happen only on explicit request.

say_en.text: Turn this Markdown into WeChat article HTML.
say_en.note: Claude checks readiness, then converts it.

say_en.text: Give me a few title options for this article.
say_en.note: Only suggests candidates; it won't finalize or publish.

say_en.text: Save this article as a draft to the configured WeChat account.
say_en.note: Credentials must be set; readiness is checked before creating the draft.
